blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Accurate multi-organ segmentation in computed tomography (CT) is essential for computer-aided diagnosis, treatment planning, and disease monitoring. However, substantial variations in organ shape and size, together with low tissue contrast and ambiguous boundaries, complicate the modeling of heterogeneous anatomical structures. To address these challenges, we propose a Morphology-Aware Channel-Decoupled Mamba Network (MCDNet), which integrates adaptive local structural enhancement with channel-decoupled long-range modeling. Specifically, we introduce a Morphology-Aware Channel-Decoupled State-Space (MCSS) block that divides feature channels into separate processing groups, allowing differentiated structural representations to be learned within an efficient state-space framework. Within each group, a Morphology-Aware Enhancement Module (MAEM) combines deformable convolutions with channel attention to adapt local feature extraction to anatomical shape variations. Group-wise state-space modeling then captures long-range spatial dependencies, and channel gating adaptively integrates the resulting features. Experiments on the Synapse abdominal CT dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of MCDNet, achieving an average Dice Similarity Coefficient of 81.61% for multi-organ segmentation.
blocks.zh: 计算机辅助诊断、治疗规划和疾病监测必须精确地进行多器官分解。 然而,器官形状和大小的巨大差异,加上组织对比度低和界限模糊,使不同解剖结构的模型制作复杂化. 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议建立一个莫菲克-阿瓦雷频道-Decoupled Mamba网络(MCDNet),该网络将适应性局部结构增强与频道断接的远程建模相结合。 具体地说,我们引入了一个莫菲克-智能通道-Decoupled State-Space(MCSS)块,将特征通道划分为单独的处理组,从而可以在高效的状态空间框架内学习不同的结构表示. 在每组内,一个自传-智能增强模块(MAEM)会将可变变形的演化和信道注意力结合起来来使局部地物提取适应解剖形状的变化. 分组状态-空间模型然后捕捉出远程空间依赖性,并因地制宜地将由此而来的特点相融合而分道扬镳. 在突触腹部CT数据集上进行的实验证明了MCDNet的有效性,实现多器官分解的平均Dice相似性系数为81.61%.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Medical image segmentation plays a vital role in clinical workflows by enabling automated delineation of organs and pathological regions to support diagnosis, treatment planning, and disease monitoring. In abdominal computed tomography (CT), substantial variations in organ shape and size, low soft-tissue contrast, and similar intensity distributions between adjacent organs obscure anatomical boundaries and complicate structure identification. These challenges require segmentation methods to capture both the global spatial context of multiple organs and the local morphological details of individual structures.
blocks.zh: 医疗图像分解在临床工作流程中发挥着至关重要的作用,能够自动划分器官和病理区域,以支持诊断、治疗规划和疾病监测。 在腹部计算成形图(CT)中,器官形状和大小的巨大差异,低软质的对比,以及相邻器官之间的类似强度分布,模糊了解剖边界,使结构识别复杂化. 这些挑战需要分化方法,既能够捕捉多种器官的全球空间背景,又能够捕捉个别结构的局部形态细节。

blocks.en: Existing approaches to medical image segmentation rely predominantly on deep learning. Convolutional neural networks with U-shaped encoder–decoder architectures, such as UNet [ 9 ] , nnUNet [ 6 ] , and UNet++ [ 17 ] , extract fine-grained features through multi-level skip connections and have become the backbone of many systems. More recently, Transformer-based models, such as Swin-Unet [ 3 ] , TransUNet [ 4 ] , and nnFormer [ 16 ] , apply self-attention mechanisms to capture long-range dependencies and global context. However, the quadratic computational complexity of self-attention with respect to the number of image tokens imposes a significant processing burden. State space models [ 5 ] address this challenge by enabling efficient long-range modeling with linear complexity, motivating a series of segmentation methods [ 13 , 18 ] , including VM-UNet [ 10 ] and Swin-UMamba [ 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 现有的医疗图像分割办法主要依靠深层学习。 带有U形编码器–解码器架构的革命神经网络,如UNet [9],nnUNet [6],和UNet++ [17],通过多层跳转连接来提取精细的纹理特征,并已成为许多系统的主干. 最近,基于变形器的模型,例如Swin-Unet [3],Trans UNet [4],以及nformer [16],应用自我关注机制来捕捉远程依赖性和全球背景. 然而,在图像符号数量方面,自我意向的四重计算复杂,造成了很大的处理负担. 国家空间模型[5] 应对这一挑战,办法是促成具有线性复杂性的高效远程模型,推动采用一系列分区方法[13、18],包括VM-UNet[10]和Swin-UMamba [8].

blocks.en: Despite these advances, efficient long-range modeling alone does not explicitly account for the morphological diversity of abdominal organs. Structures with different shapes and spatial extents require different local representations, while subtle contours between adjacent organs are difficult to resolve using global context alone. Processing all feature channels through a shared state-space transformation may also limit the capacity to represent these heterogeneous structural patterns separately. These observations motivate a joint design that adapts local feature extraction to organ morphology and decouples channel processing to support differentiated structural representations.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进步,但单靠高效的长距离建模并不能明确反映腹部器官的形态多样性. 具有不同形状和空间范围的结构需要不同的局部代表,而相邻器官之间的微妙轮廓则难以仅利用全球背景来解决. 通过共享的状态空间转换处理所有特征通道,也可能限制单独代表这些不同结构模式的能力。 这些观测激发了一种联合设计,使局部特征提取适应器官形态和脱钩通道处理,以支持有区别的结构表示.

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we introduce MCDNet, which integrates morphology-aware enhancement and channel-decoupled state-space modeling within a U-shaped encoder–decoder. Our Morphology-Aware Channel-Decoupled State-Space (MCSS) block divides feature channels into separate processing groups. In each group, a Morphology-Aware Enhancement Module (MAEM) adjusts convolutional sampling locations and reweights channel responses to capture local shape variations, followed by a State-Space 2D (SS2D) unit for long-range spatial modeling. An adaptive channel gate integrates the group outputs. This design connects local morphological adaptation with efficient global context modeling while allowing different channel groups to learn complementary structural features. Our contributions are as follows: ∙ \bullet We propose MCDNet, which integrates morphology-aware local enhancement with channel-decoupled state-space modeling for medical image segmentation. ∙ \bullet We design an MCSS block that processes channel groups separately and adaptively integrates their outputs, together with an MAEM that uses deformable sampling and channel attention to capture diverse anatomical morphologies. ∙ \bullet Experiments on the Synapse abdominal CT dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of MCDNet, which achieves the highest average DSC among the compared methods.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了MCDNet,将形态感知增强和通道脱钩的状态空间模型整合在一个U形的编码器-解码器内. 我们的肿瘤学-智能频道-Decooppled State-Space(MCSS)块将特征频道分成不同的处理组. 在每个组中,一个摩尔phology-Aware增强模块(MAEM)调整了演化采样位置,并重新对通道响应进行加权,以捕捉局部形状变化,之后是用于远程空间模型的国-空间2D(SS2D)单元. 适应性信道门集成组产出. 这种设计将局部形态适应与高效的全球环境建模联系起来,同时允许不同的频道组学习互补的结构特征. 我们的捐款如下: 我们提出MCDNet,它将形态感知局部增强与通道脱钩的状态-空间模型结合,用于医疗图像分割. * 弹夹 我们设计了一个MCSS块来分别和适应性地处理信道组, 以及一个使用变形取样的MAEM, 并引导注意力来捕捉不同的解剖形态。 *\Bullet 突触腹部CT数据集上的实验显示MCDNet的有效性,在比较方法中达到最高平均DSC.

blocks.en: We propose MCDNet, which integrates morphology-aware local enhancement with channel-decoupled state-space modeling for medical image segmentation.
blocks.zh: 我们提出MCDNet,它将形态感知局部增强与通道脱钩的状态-空间模型结合,用于医疗图像分割.

blocks.en: We design an MCSS block that processes channel groups separately and adaptively integrates their outputs, together with an MAEM that uses deformable sampling and channel attention to capture diverse anatomical morphologies.

blocks.en: 2 Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 2.1 概览

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 1 -(a), MCDNet first embeds the input CT slice into patches and processes the resulting features through a U-shaped encoder–decoder built from MCSS blocks. Each block combines morphology-aware local enhancement with channel-decoupled long-range modeling. A final class projection produces a segmentation tensor of size H × W × C H\times W\times C , where C C denotes the number of anatomical classes.
blocks.zh: 如图1-(a)所示,MCDNet首先将输入的CT切片嵌入到补丁中,并通过由MCSS块构建的U形编码器-解码器处理由此产生的特性. 每个区块将形态感知局部增强与通道脱钩远程建模结合. 最终的类投影会产生大小 H × W × C H\times W\times C 的分数角,其中C表示解剖类的数量.

blocks.en: 2.2 Morphology-Aware Channel-Decoupled State-Space Block
blocks.zh: 2.2 口腔-智能频道-国家空间区

As shown in Figure 1 -(b), it incorporates an MAEM into each group before SS2D-based spatial modeling, allowing local shape information and long-range context to be modeled within the same processing stream. The group count is set to the number of segmentation classes, providing an anatomical basis for the channel decomposition. The resulting groups provide separate feature streams in which differentiated structural representations are learned end to end through segmentation supervision. blocks.en: 2.3 Morphology-Aware Enhancement Module
blocks.zh: 2.3 耳科-意识增强 模块

blocks.en: To explicitly model local morphological variation, we introduce an MAEM within each channel group. Organs vary in shape, scale, and boundary geometry, making a fixed sampling pattern potentially insufficient for their local representation. MAEM predicts deformable convolutional offsets from the input features to adapt sampling locations to local image structure. Depthwise–pointwise convolutions then refine the sampled responses, and channel attention selectively weights the resulting features. These operations are combined within a residual framework to preserve the input representation. blocks.en: Deformable sampling provides spatial adaptation to local shape variation, while channel attention adjusts the importance of the extracted responses. Within an MCSS block, MAEM therefore provides morphology-aware local features for the subsequent group-wise state-space transformation, complementing its long-range spatial modeling.

blocks.en: 2.4 End-to-End Learning
blocks.zh: 2.4 端到端学习

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3 个实验

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集

blocks.en: We evaluate our approach on the Synapse Multi-Organ Segmentation dataset [ 7 ] , a publicly available collection of 30 abdominal CT cases comprising 3,779 axial CT slices. We report segmentation performance for eight anatomical structures: the aorta, gallbladder, left kidney, right kidney, liver, pancreas, spleen, and stomach.
blocks.zh: 我们评价我们对突触多组织分块数据集[7]的方法,该数据集是公开收集的30个腹部CT病例,包括3 779个轴心CT片。 我们报告8个解剖结构的分化性能:主动脉、胆囊、左肾、右肾、肝、胰腺、脾和胃。

blocks.en: 3.2 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 3.2 评价计量

blocks.en: We evaluate segmentation performance using the Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC) and the 95% Hausdorff Distance (HD95). DSC measures the overlap between predicted and ground-truth segmentations, while HD95 assesses boundary discrepancy. Higher DSC and lower HD95 indicate better performance.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Dice相似性系数(DSC)和95%的Husdorff距离(HD95)来评价分化性能. DSC测量预测和地面真实分区之间的重叠,而HD95评估边界差异。 较高的DSC和较低的HD95显示性能更好.

blocks.en: 3.3 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 3.3 详细执行情况

blocks.en: We trained our model on a GeForce RTX 4090 GPU for 300 epochs. CT slices were resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 , with a batch size of 22 and an initial learning rate of 1 × 10 − 3 1\times 10^{-3} .

blocks.en: 3.4 Comparison with State-of-the-Art Methods
blocks.zh: 3.4 与最新方法的比较

blocks.en: We compare MCDNet with recent state-of-the-art medical image segmentation methods on the Synapse abdominal CT dataset. Quantitative results are reported in Table 1 . MCDNet achieves the highest average DSC of 81.61% among the compared methods, improving upon VM-UNet and MedMamba by 0.53 and 0.94 percentage points, respectively. Compared with VM-UNet, MCDNet increases the DSC for the pancreas from 58.80% to 63.57% and for the spleen from 89.51% to 90.90%. These results demonstrate the performance of MCDNet across organs with diverse morphologies. Its design combines local morphological adaptation with channel-decoupled long-range modeling. MCDNet achieves an HD95 of 23.72, although several compared methods obtain lower HD95 values.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了MCDNet与Synapse腹部CT数据集上最近最先进的医学图像分解方法. 表1报告了量化结果。 在比较方法中,MCDNet的平均DSC最高,为81.61%,比VM-UNet和MedMamba分别提高了0.53和0.94个百分点。 与VM-UNet相比,MCDNet将胰腺的DSC从58.80%增加到63.57%,脾脏的DSC从89.51%增加到90.90%. 这些结果表明,MCDNet在具有不同形态的器官中的表现。 其设计结合了局部形态适应和通道脱钩的远程模型. MCDNet实现23.72的HD95,虽然几种比较方法获得较低的HD95值.

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: We propose MCDNet, a Morphology-Aware Channel-Decoupled Mamba Network for medical image segmentation. Its MCSS block processes channel groups separately to learn differentiated structural representations and captures long-range spatial context through SS2D. Within each group, MAEM uses deformable sampling and channel attention to adapt local feature extraction to anatomical shape variations. Adaptive channel gating integrates the group outputs, connecting morphology-aware enhancement with channel-decoupled state-space modeling. Experiments on the Synapse abdominal CT dataset demonstrate improved average segmentation accuracy over the compared methods, achieving an average DSC of 81.61%.
blocks.zh: 我们提议建立MCDNet,这是一个用于医疗图像分解的肿瘤学-智能频道-十足的曼巴网络。 其MCSS块块处理通道组单独进行,通过SS2D学习不同结构的表示,并捕捉远程空间背景. 在每个组内,MAEM使用变形采样和引导注意力,使局部特征提取适应解剖形状的变化. 适应性通道Gating集成分组输出,将形态感知增强与通道解耦的状态-空间模型连接起来. 对突触腹部CT数据集的实验显示,在比较方法上,平均分化精度有所提高,平均DSC为81.61%.
